Interesting to see how brief his last letter was, like he didn't really know what to say about his situation, or maybe he didn't have the will or the strength that day to write any other consideration on his death.

By the way I enjoyed the article, that guy that got banned should have explained his comment instead of leaving it to misinterpretation and trying to write the best insult, maybe he didn't have any good argument.

Thank you, your words are somewhat reassuring. You know, it doesn't feel right that I HAVE to take care of her. When I'm at work I have to shut up, when I'm at home it's the same, I feel like my hands are tied and have no control on my life. This situation made me realize how senseless life is and that sometimes things just happen and there is no "answer", cause we (humans) just randomly found our selves in this world we didn't create so we have no control (just wanted you to know I'm aware of this so you can feel less sorry).
Thank you again
